violations.text: The required utensil surface temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit was not achieved during the sanitizing cycle of the high temperature dishwasher as evidenced by the failure of the thermo-label (temperature indicator) affixed to the surface of a utensil to turn black. Per the PIC, 3 bay sink is to be used for proper sanitizing of equipment until unit is serviced/repaired. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the deli slicer were observed to have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces of utensils and equipment are to be cleaned as often as necessary to preclude the buildup of residue and debris. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
